urls.title: Websites
urls.description: Up to 100 websites or domains, for example "stripe.com". Each site's homepage is checked once.

renderJs.title: Render JavaScript
renderJs.description: Load the page in a browser to catch technologies that only appear after scripts run. Slower and uses more memory.

includeCategories.title: Only these categories
includeCategories.description: Optional list such as "CMS", "Analytics" or "Ecommerce". Leave empty to report everything found.

maxConcurrency.title: Sites at the same time
maxConcurrency.description: How many sites are checked in parallel. Default 5, or 2 when rendering JavaScript.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout per site (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one site may take. Default 45.
